[Intro]

The treehouse roof is caving in right now

[Pre-Chorus]
Now the years just slip right through my hands
Like water falling into golden sands

[Chorus]
Take me back to the porch swing nights
Fireflies dancing in the warm twilight
Oh, I miss the days when the world was small
Before we grew up, before we had to fall
Take me back, take me back

[Bridge]
Mama’s voice calling from the door
I don’t hear that sweet sound anymore
Just the echo of a simpler time
Living in this rhythm and this rhyme

[Chorus]
Take me back to the porch swing nights
Fireflies dancing in the warm twilight
Oh, I miss the days when the world was small
Before we grew up, before we had to fall
Take me back, take me back

[Outro]
Fading light, hold me tight
Take me back...
